title: Carbon Finance Initiatives Can Provide Biodiversity Benefits
abstract: Carbon finance initiatives such as Reducing Deforestation and Forest Degradation (REDD+), designed to mitigate climate change, offer an opportunity to also protect biodiversity. However, managing forests to store and sequester carbon does not necessarily conserve biodiversity. We evaluated the biodiversity co‐benefits of the Gola‐REDD+ initiative in the tropical forests of Sierra Leone, using bioacoustics and DNA metabarcoding under a quasi‐experimental study design. We used soundscape saturation (SS) as a measure of vocalizing diversity, and e‐DNA arthropod community as a complementary measure of biodiversity to examine whether a Gola‐REDD+ financed protected area (Treatment‐PA) conserved biodiversity more than (1) a multiuse community land (Control‐CL) and (2) a PA without REDD+ finance (Control‐PA). We found that REDD+ financing is associated with additional biodiversity co‐benefits in the Treatment‐PA compared to both control areas. Our study makes three key contributions. First, we provide concrete evidence on a carbon finance (REDD+) project's effectiveness in conserving faunal diversity while sequestering carbon. Second, we present a gold‐standard causal inference study design for evaluating biodiversity co‐benefits of conservation strategies. Third, we highlight the role of conservation technologies like bioacoustics and DNA metabarcoding in informing conservation policy.
abstract_zh: 旨在减缓气候变化的碳金融倡议，如“减少毁林和森林退化所致排放”（REDD+），同时也为保护生物多样性提供了机会。然而，为储存和封存碳而管理森林，并不一定能保护生物多样性。我们利用生物声学和DNA宏条形码技术，在准实验设计下评估了塞拉利昂热带森林中Gola-REDD+倡议的生物多样性协同效益。我们以声景饱和度（SS）作为发声生物多样性的度量，并以环境DNA（e-DNA）节肢动物群落作为生物多样性的补充度量，以检验由Gola-REDD+资助的保护区（处理组PA）是否比（1）多用途社区土地（对照组CL）以及（2）未获得REDD+资金支持的保护区（对照组PA）更好地保护了生物多样性。我们发现，与两个对照区域相比，REDD+资金与处理组保护区中额外的生物多样性协同效益相关。我们的研究有三项主要贡献。第一，我们为碳金融（REDD+）项目在封存碳的同时保护动物多样性的有效性提供了具体证据。第二，我们提出了一种评估保护策略生物多样性协同效益的“黄金标准”因果推断研究设计。第三，我们强调了生物声学和DNA宏条形码等保护技术在为保护政策提供信息方面的作用。

abstract_zh: 衡量捕食者所带来的经济效益十分困难，因为其影响往往是间接的，并通过复杂的生态变化而发生。因此，关于扩大捕食者种群的争论，常常将显著的成本与较为推测性的效益估计相对立，而后者可能被视为不可靠或出于意识形态动机而遭到摒弃。我们量化了狼（Canis lupus）通过减少鹿与车辆碰撞，为人类生命和财产带来的间接效益。此外，我们将该效应分解为两个组成部分：猎物行为的变化与猎物数量的变化。当有效的政策取决于猎人能否复制捕食者的作用时，这一分解尤为重要。就狼而言，我们的结论是：人类猎鹿者无法做到这一点。

title: Can Native Species Compete with Valuable Exotics? Valuing Ecological Changes in the Lake Michigan Recreational Fishery
Ensemble Random Forests as a Tool for Modeling Rare Occurrences
abstract: Relative to target species, priority conservation species occur rarely in fishery interactions, resulting in imbalanced, overdispersed data. We present Ensemble Random Forests (ERFs) as an intuitive extension of the Random Forest algorithm to handle rare event bias. Each Random Forest receives individual stratified randomly sampled training/test sets, then down-samples the majority class for each decision tree. Results are averaged across Random Forests to generate an ensemble prediction. Through simulation, we show that ERFs outperform Random Forest with and without down-sampling, as well as with the synthetic minority over-sampling technique, for highly class imbalanced to balanced datasets. Spatial covariance greatly impacts ERFs’ perceived performance, as shown through simulation and case studies. In case studies from the Hawaii deep-set longline fishery, giant manta rayMobula birostrissyn. Manta birostrisand scalloped hammerheadSphyrna lewinipresence had high spatial covariance and high model test performance, while false killer whalePseudorca crassidenshad low spatial covariance and low model test performance. Overall, we find ERFs have 4 advantages: (1) reduced successive partitioning effects; (2) prediction uncertainty propagation; (3) better accounting for interacting covariates through balancing; and (4) minimization of false positives, as the majority of Random Forests within the ensemble vote correctly. As ERFs can readily mitigate rare event bias without requiring large presence sample sizes or imparting considerable balancing bias, they are likely to be a valuable tool in bycatch and species distribution modeling, as well as spatial conservation planning, especially for protected species where presence can be rare.
abstract_zh: 相对于目标物种，优先保护物种在渔业兼捕中很少出现，导致数据不平衡且过度离散。我们提出集成随机森林（ERFs）作为随机森林算法的一种直观扩展，用以处理稀有事件偏差。每个随机森林接收独立的分层随机抽样训练/测试集，然后对每棵决策树对多数类进行下采样。各随机森林的结果取平均，以生成集成预测。通过模拟，我们表明，对于从高度类别不平衡到平衡的数据集，ERFs的表现优于随机森林（无论是否进行下采样），也优于合成少数类过采样技术（SMOTE）。空间协方差极大地影响了ERFs的表现感知，这在模拟和案例研究中均有体现。在夏威夷深海延绳钓渔业的案例研究中，巨型蝠鲼（Mobula birostris，异名Manta birostris）和双髻鲨（Sphyrna lewini）的出现具有较高的空间协方差和较高的模型测试表现，而伪虎鲸（Pseudorca crassidens）的出现空间协方差较低，模型测试表现也较低。总体而言，我们发现ERFs具有四项优势：（1）减少连续划分效应；（2）预测不确定性的传播；（3）通过平衡更好地处理相互作用的协变量；以及（4）最小化假阳性，因为集成中的大多数随机森林都能正确投票。由于ERFs能够在不要求大量出现样本、也不引入显著平衡偏差的情况下缓解稀有事件偏差，它们很可能成为兼捕与物种分布建模以及空间保护规划中的有价值工具，特别是对于出现可能非常稀少的受保护物种。

title: Impact of Two of the World's Largest Protected Areas on Longline Fishery Catch Rates
abstract: Two of the largest protected areas on earth are U.S. National Monuments in the Pacific Ocean. Numerous claims have been made about the impacts of these protected areas on the fishing industry, but there has been no ex post empirical evaluation of their effects. We use administrative data documenting individual fishing events to evaluate the economic impact of the expansion of these two monuments on the Hawaii longline fishing fleet. Surprisingly, catch and catch-per-unit-effort are higher since the expansions began. To disentangle the causal effect of the expansions from confounding factors, we use unaffected control fisheries to perform a difference-in-differences analysis. We find that the monument expansions had little, if any, negative impacts on the fishing industry, corroborating ecological models that have predicted minimal impacts from closing large parts of the Pacific Ocean to fishing.
abstract_zh: 地球上两个最大的保护区是位于太平洋的美国国家纪念地。关于这些保护区对渔业影响的说法很多，但尚无对其影响的事后实证评估。我们利用记录个体捕鱼事件的行政数据，评估这两个纪念地扩展对夏威夷延绳钓渔船队的经济影响。令人意外的是，自扩展开始以来，渔获量和单位捕捞努力量渔获量反而更高。为了将扩展的因果效应与混杂因素区分开来，我们利用未受影响的对照渔业进行双重差分分析。我们发现，纪念地扩展对渔业的负面影响即便存在，也很小，这印证了生态模型的预测，即关闭太平洋大片区域的捕鱼活动对渔业的影响极小。
